items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I heard of him. He had one on Claiborne between Columbus and Calarac.

ctx.x: Yeah. Thanks for that. They had a barber shop uptown. Yeah, what about Paul Dominguez? Do you remember Paul Dominguez?
I heard of him. He had one on Claiborne between Columbus and Calarac. Yeah, yeah, well I heard of him. I didn't know much about it.
Were there some barber shops around the Big 25 or Elk Place or something? Yeah, but I didn't know none of them.
